residuals.basis: Controller state exposes navigationState, orbitFocus, selection, orientation, clusters, and semanticProjection, but no independent contextual-origin/current-subject authority pointer was found. Repository search returned no contextOrigin or currentSubject implementation.

Frozen canonical law/member runtime records exist independently of screen projection, but their records are Laws-specific and contain identity/direction/label/route/class/source rather than the frozen generic O fields identity, objectClass, authority, version, provenance.
Presentation metadata can carry a relationship string, but no authoritative R_OC record with relation class, directionality, scope, authority, evidence, version, and status was found.

Current controller resolves fixed direction membership, route identity, focus, selection, and projection eligibility; no authority was found that computes Gamma(O,C) from an authoritative object and contextual origin.
Current transactions cover orbit/cluster preview, commit, cancel, category/law/member selection, and bounded returns. No transaction changes an independent contextual origin from C0 to C1=O*.
Because no contextual-origin transaction or Gamma resolver exists, no post-recenter relation recomputation mechanism exists.

Semantic projection has an explicit revision channel and update mechanism, but updates consume renderer/compositor projection records for the fixed field; no contextual-relation change trigger was found.

Current Laws preserves committed orientations and gesture origins and retains selected direction during bounded return transitions, but it has no general prior contextual-origin snapshot or context history for C0->C1 restoration.

Return-to-orbit and return-to-constellation lawfully restore bounded Laws navigation/orientation states, including previousDirection, but cannot restore an arbitrary prior contextual origin because such an origin is not represented.
A generic terminal SYSTEM_HELD state exists and disables interaction on runtime failure, but there is no relation-specific UNKNOWN/UNEVALUABLE status or non-deceptive unresolved spatial disposition.

Current canonical law/member identities and routes remain stable through existing focus/selection/orientation changes, but provenance/version authority fields are not part of those runtime records and no contextual-origin change exists to verify the full invariant.

Orbit focus, selection, and semantic screen projection are already independently represented. The fourth authority, contextual origin C, is absent, so the complete four-way separation is not yet executable.
